reviews.snippet: Best beef noodle soup outside of Taiwan. The broth is rich and the noodles have the perfect chew. We drive 30 minutes just for this place.
Solid dan dan noodles and generous portions. A bit of a wait during lunch rush but worth it.
Noodles were cold when they arrived and we waited 40 minutes for a table on a Tuesday night. Disappointing.
Found a hair in my soup. Staff argued with me instead of apologizing. Never coming back.
